scope: Proposition 9.1 (Conditioned precision bounds) of the manuscript “Critical mixing in the Sherrington–Kirkpatrick model” (preprints/Critical-mixing-in-the-Sherrington-Kirkpatrick-model-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 227 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3ac6296cc238bae9), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 37. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix a sufficiently small η > 0, an accuracy ϵ > 0, and a budget B > 0. On retained scalar data with the required accuracies, the following estimates hold with the integrated exclusion specified below. For K ∈ {K, Ko, KT }, K ⪰ (1 − ϵ)q2 I, Tr K−2 ≤ Cn/q, ∥A0K−1/2 ∥ ≤ Cq−η , A0 = 2I − J. (9.1) For Ko the last bound holds with η = 0. Each precision has at least cAnq3 eigenvalues below CAq2, and Tr K−1 o = nb + o( p n/q). For K ∈ {K, Ko}, the three projection bounds are uT K−1 u ≤ CAq−2 , eT K−1 e ≤ CAq−1 , cT 3 K−1 c3 ≤ CA. Let S be the retained scalar set, let Gspec be the original spectral event, and let Fy be failure of any estimate above. In the conditional law Qy of Lemma 8.1, the bound is Z S G(y) Qy(Gspec ∩ Fy) dy ≤ nC e−Bk . The same bound with the determinant weight follows after increasing the preliminary budget. The spectral restriction stays inside the event being estimated; the argument does not condition on its probability.
